obs: “and in the absence of express prohibition would be therefore assignable.”
"Those rights he could convey unless prohibited by law."

"A property right, the ownership of which may be conveyed to and vested in a purchaser, must be accorded the quality of inheritability, which usually attaches as an incident of ownership, in the absence of some provision of law to the contrary"
“the longstanding . . . canon of [statutory] construction disfavoring extraterritoriality, 499 U. S., at 248, would have required the same result even if Chevron applied.”
